winner.noWinner: Results are out. Every entrant is a Contestant.
winner.myReadersChoice: Also Readers’ choice: classmates gave these chapters the most points.

grade.title: School year
grade.intro: A class competition needs the school year. Below the 8th there is no Winner and no Finalist: every entrant is a Contestant.
grade.label: School year
grade.archived: This class is archived, so the school year stays as it is.

form.intro: Pupils see the name, the dates and every criterion from the start, and choose whether to join.
form.teacherOnly: Only the teacher of this class runs its competitions.
form.locked: Pupils have joined or the competition has ended, so it can’t change.
form.name: Name
form.nameHint: It also prints on the certificates. At most 120 characters.
form.datesHint: The last day comes before the class closes.
form.criteriaIntro: 1 to 6 criteria. Each one says what the work must have, as at school.
form.label: Label
form.outcomesHint: 1 to 8 lines saying what the work must have, for example “uses dialogue to show character”.
form.templateUsed: Criteria copied from “{{name}}”. Changes here leave the template as it is.
form.templateEmpty: No templates yet. Write criteria below and save them as a template.

scoring.title: Assess the entries
scoring.intro: Score each entrant on each criterion. Class points and teacher points are a guide only. Nobody is ranked and the app names no Winner: the teacher decides.
scoring.teacherOnly: Only the teacher of this class sees this page.
scoring.loadFailed: We couldn’t load the entries. Check the connection and try again.
scoring.notYet: Scores open once the competition ends.
scoring.noEntrants: Nobody joined this competition, so there are no results. It can be deleted from the class page.
scoring.noChapters: No chapters shared with the class.
scoring.checklistHint: Tick what the work has. Ticks are a guide and aren’t saved.
scoring.notScored: Not scored on every criterion yet.
scoring.winnerHint: Exactly one. On equal totals the teacher decides.
scoring.winningChapter: Winning chapter shown to the class
scoring.finalistsHint: Any number. Everyone else who joined is a Contestant.
scoring.noWinners: In this school year there is no Winner and no Finalist. Every entrant is a Contestant.
scoring.confirmQuestion: Results can’t change after this. The Winner is told first, then the class.
scoring.published: Results are confirmed and locked. They are in the class log.

templates.title: Criteria templates
templates.intro: Saved sets of criteria, private to this account. Changing or deleting a template leaves competitions made from it as they are.

failures.not_entrant: Only pupils who joined get a score or a result.
failures.unscored: Score the Winner and every Finalist on every criterion first.
failures.chapter: Choose one of the Winner’s chapters shared with this class.
